question: Are P4AZ transmittance moments materially sensitive to choosing a Gaussian density marginal when only mean and diffuse-rms density are identified?

branch_rule.pass: Retain a three-family transmittance-moment interval as marginal-robust amplitude evidence; keep spatial structure unidentified.
branch_rule.fail: Keep P4AZ Gaussian compatibility explicit and close the interval compiler without adding marginals or changing gates.

forbidden: select a spatial NPS or grain radius
fit a marginal to photographs or scanner grain samples
claim the tested marginals exhaust physical emulsion structure
render photographs or alter product defaults
claim_ceiling: Sensitivity of the P4AZ transmittance moments to three explicit equal-mean/equal-variance density marginals; no identified marginal, spatial NPS, emulsion geometry, calibration or product claim.
